entry.name: mc.assign
entry.description: The mc.assign object assigns MC channels to incoming messages (numbers, lists, and symbols) according to patterns of channels and delays you define.

attributes.name: delays
attributes.digest: Delay Times
attributes.description: Theattribute sets a repeating pattern of delay times used when iterating through a chord in a pattern. For example, ifis set toand there is a four-item chord in a pattern (such as), an incoming messages will output on channel 1 immediately, then output on channel 2 100ms later, then output on channel 3 200ms after that, then finally output on channel 4 100ms after that (because the delay pattern repeats). To clear theattribute and output all messages in a chord simulataneously, send the messagewith no arguments or the word.

attributes.digest: Event Density
attributes.description: Determines the probability of playing an event when a pattern element is aor. Whenis set to 0.9, there is a 90% chance an incoming message will be sent out and 10% chance it will be skipped.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Mode
attributes.description: Theattribute determines how incoming messages are handled by the currentand.

choices.label: Each incoming message progresses through the complete pattern.
Each incoming message uses one element of the current pattern, advancing to the next message to be used on the next incoming message.

Each incoming message progresses through the complete pattern. Groups of pattern elements (within vertical bars) are broken into individual numbers; the pattern advances, outputting one list element at a time until the both end of the list and the end of the pattern are reached. If the pattern is shorter than the list, it will repeat from the beginning. If the list is shorter than the pattern it will repeat from the beginning.
